scope: Exploratory independent ATT-only reader refit diagnostic; no change to locked primary attack slate, comparator selection, or utility gate

arm_selection.nominee: J when J passes the frozen two-seed point utility gate; otherwise use only an arm already nominated by R0's frozen rule, if any, and do not attribute a joint result to it
arm_selection.comparator: strongest eligible within-bank control under the already frozen eligible-control rule; do not use a best draw or post-attack comparator switch
arm_selection.same_arm: skip duplicate refit unit and record alias

units.split: fixed 1015-group SHA256 ATT tune split from inherited attack contract
units.resource: queue stage verification; each unit counts all model fits and predictions

readers.random_state: same fixed R4 attacker_seed for exact model replay

reporting: Compare each refit on identical complete pair wires and aligned people; report all seeds and the fixed draw. The stronger diagnostic can expose leakage but cannot be used to choose a method or draw.
